findings: Definition, lawful task responses, precision, deadlines and full resource costs precede architecture construction; numerical fixture factors do not select a brain law.
Canonical future-response states are abstract minimal realizations on reachable states, not effective finite algorithms; finite Bool alphabets can still require infinite exact memory.
Uniform approximation certificates compose only under their registered full-update and same-input premises; language epsilon/L/delta and reference-world mismatch remain unassigned.
Separated histories require common lawful suffixes and a code fixed beforehand; fixed-query communication uses M_query and includes addresses, timing, silence and side information.

Combinations and temporal response windows are counted; lifetime observations and microscopic nonrecurrence do not imply infinite readable memory. Unbounded host counters are not free finite-body storage.
Exact implicit topology, integer range checks and packed allocator measurements cover declared operators and storage, not complete model memory, throughput or language superiority.
Finite modification compares old-model joint event support with global support; separate favorable edits need not combine favorably or improve independent future behavior.
Given positive joint mass, the conditioned hidden law is normalized and unique; prefix fixture factors share readout/transition codes but do not identify the physical or language law.

Whole-byte scoring and posterior sampling use the same frozen old frame before edits; generation RNG is isolated, semantic checkpoint versions differ, and combined input is rejected before consuming reference state.
Public-prefix replay binds actual source SHA only on the audit side, freezes request intervals and excludes future or pre-origin bytes; it is not train-only retrieval.
One slot suffices for implicit request identity here; positive delay, paid holding/readout, cancellation and all-prefix resource balances are checked without a new identity or memory module.

Delivered bytes are current auxiliary input, supplied identically to old-frame prediction and conditioned transition. World snapshots retain any open receipt; model snapshots add no persistent auxiliary field.
Real OWT uses fixed requests and zero parameter updates. Same-old-state information cuts establish channel use, not learned acquisition, predictive gain or policy benefit.
Resource-cut scoring covers all fresh bytes after absorbing failure using uniform256 fallback with the port frozen; NLL never mints resources and declared fees are not calibrated joules.
Trusted whole-loop JSON audit copies world, port, ledger fields and bridge counter. Public world/port loaders validate before mutation; this adds no generic untrusted ledger loader.
Finite EOF, discrete delays and fixed external supply do not establish unbounded novelty, pathwise survival, active resource acquisition or an independent wall-clock producer.
Optional pretrained sensory weights and workspace remain separate costs; offline sensor checks do not establish official-weight inference or integration with the new byte replay world.

Binary factor modification exposes joint contrast: equal hidden/output marginals can give opposite edit directions. This is a conditional local-operator counterexample, not identified world causality or actual language-state reachability.
The generic identity adds one source theorem and two automatic simp helpers. All 796 previous source theorems and 1366 source declaration signatures are preserved; core Lean net +2 lines.
Preserving a current prediction or decision sign does not establish recursive closure under learning. No covariance cache, per-parameter eligibility or complete R was introduced.
